name: materials_catalysis_pack
description: Neglected materials / catalysis unknowns with measurable operationalizations.

questions.question: Which descriptors best predict synthesizability of hypothetical inorganic catalysts proposed by generative models under ambient pressure?
questions.operationalization: Descriptors that raise prospective lab synthesis success ≥20% absolute over formation-energy-only filters on a held-out set of ≥50 proposals.
questions.why_it_matters: Unsynthesizable catalyst proposals waste experimental cycles and slow climate-relevant chemistry.
assumptions: Lab groups report attempt outcomes consistently.

questions.question: How does active-site heterogeneity under operando conditions change selectivity predictions from idealized single-site models?
questions.operationalization: Quantify prediction error of single-site DFT/ML models vs operando-informed ensembles on ≥3 reactions with measured site distributions.
questions.why_it_matters: Idealized active sites mislead catalyst design when real surfaces are dynamic.
assumptions: Operando spectroscopy can constrain site distributions.
